title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) Students
scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SCs
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Click 'Applicant Corner' -> Complete Aadhaar e-KYC OTR registration.
3. Log in -> Under 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment', click 'Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students'.
4. Enter digital Caste Certificate number & Tehsildar Income Certificate (<= 2.5 Lakhs).
5. Submit form online and ensure bank account has active DBT/NPCI mapping.
brief_summary: Comprehensive financial support for SC students studying from Class 11 up to Post-Doctoral degrees. Covers 100% compulsory non-refundable college tuition fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month. Annual family income ceiling: ₹2.5 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Universal Higher Education Access for Scheduled Caste Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 10th / Matriculation and enrolled in recognized Post-Matric course
eligible_institutions: All Govt, Govt-Aided, and Recognized Private Universities/Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Candidate must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) community. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2.50 Lakhs. Enrolled in recognized post-matric course (Class 11, 12, Diploma, Degree, PG, PhD).

financials.raw_budget_text: Full reimbursement of all non-refundable compulsory fees (tuition, library, exam, sports fee) plus monthly maintenance allowance from Rs. 4,000 to Rs. 13,500 per annum depending on course group.

full_text_content:
MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT
POST MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP FOR SC STUDENTS
Coverage: Full Tuition & Compulsory Fee waiver + Monthly Maintenance Allowance.
Eligibility: SC category, Family Income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakhs per year. Apply via NSP portal.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Complete student verification with Aadhaar to generate OTR.
3. In the scholarship application menu, select 'Ministry of Tribal Affairs' -> 'Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students'.
4. Upload ST Caste Certificate and Tehsildar Income Certificate (<= 2.5 Lakhs).
5. Final submit and deliver physical document copy to your College Nodal Officer.
brief_summary: Universal educational grant covering full tuition fees, book grants, and maintenance allowances for ST students pursuing Class 11, 12, Diploma, Professional Degrees (Engineering/MBBS), and PG/PhD courses. Family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Educational Upliftment & Full Fee Support for Scheduled Tribe Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 10th and admitted to post-matric educational institution
eligible_institutions: Govt & UGC/AICTE Recognized Institutions across India
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Candidate must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST). Annual family income <= Rs. 2.50 Lakhs. Enrolled in post-matric studies.

financials.raw_budget_text: 100% Tuition fee refund + monthly hostel/day-scholar allowance + study tour and thesis typing charges.

full_text_content:
MINISTRY OF TRIBAL AFFAIRS
POST-MATRIC SCHOLARSHIPS FOR ST STUDENTS 2026
Full fee reimbursement and maintenance stipend for Tribal students across India. Income limit: Rs 2.5L/year.

title: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT Students
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Create your OTR credentials via Aadhaar e-KYC.
3. Log in -> Under 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment', choose 'PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT Students'.
4. Upload OBC-NCL / EBC / DNT certificate and family income proof (<= 2.5 Lakhs).
5. Review details and submit online.
brief_summary: Flagship central scheme for Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT). Provides tuition fee assistance and maintenance allowance up to ₹45,000/year for higher studies.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Empowering OBC, EBC, and Nomadic Tribe Youth in Higher Education

eligibility.min_qualification: Class 10th passed with valid OBC/EBC/DNT certificate
eligible_institutions: Recognized Schools, Polytechnics, and Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Belonging to OBC / EBC / DNT categories. Family income must not exceed Rs. 2.5 Lakhs per annum.

financials.raw_budget_text: Financial assistance covering academic fees and maintenance allowance up to Rs. 45,000 per annum depending on the course group.

full_text_content:
PM YASASVI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME
Target: OBC, EBC, and DNT students pursuing Post-Matric education.
Allowance: Up to Rs. 45,000/year. Family income <= Rs. 2.50 Lakhs/year.

title: UGC Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
scheme_name: Ishan Uday Scholarship for North East
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Complete student verification with your North East state permanent address.
3. In the application list, click 'University Grants Commission (UGC)' -> 'Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for NER'.
4. Upload North-Eastern State Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) & Class 12 marksheet.
5. Submit form before closing date.
brief_summary: 10,000 dedicated scholarships per year for students with domicile in the North Eastern states (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim). Provides ₹5,400/month for General Degree and ₹7,800/month for Technical, Medical, and Professional courses.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Promoting Higher & Professional Education among North-East Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 12th from NER and enrolled in 1st year of recognized UG program
eligible_institutions: Any recognized Indian University / College (in NER or elsewhere in India)
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Students with domicile of North Eastern Region (NER) who have passed Class XII or equivalent examination from a school situated within NER. Enrolled in 1st year general or professional degree. Annual family income <= Rs. 4.5 Lakhs.

financials.raw_budget_text: Rs. 5,400 per month for general degree courses; Rs. 7,800 per month for technical, medical, engineering, and professional degree courses (disbursed for 10 months per year).

full_text_content:
UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION (UGC)
ISHAN UDAY SPECIAL SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR NER
1. Objective: Equal opportunity for higher education to students of North Eastern states.
2. Slots: 10,000 fresh awards every year.
3. Rate: Rs. 5,400/mo (General degree) | Rs. 7,800/mo (Engineering/Medical/Professional degree).
4. Eligibility: Domicile of NER state, passed 12th from NER, family income <= 4.5 Lakhs.

title: UGC Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
scheme_name: PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Complete student One Time Registration (OTR).
3. Under 'University Grants Commission (UGC)', select 'PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child'.
4. Upload Single Girl Child Affidavit on ₹50/100 Stamp Paper sworn before First Class Magistrate / SDM.
5. Upload 1st year PG Master's course admission receipt and submit.
brief_summary: Empowers single girl children to pursue non-professional Master's postgraduate education. Provides ₹36,200 per annum for 2 years (Full PG tenure) for female students who are the only child of their parents.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Encouraging Higher Education for Single Girl Children in Families

eligibility.min_qualification: Admitted to 1st year regular, full-time Master's (PG) course in any recognized university
eligible_institutions: All UGC Recognized Central, State, Deemed & Private Universities
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Any single girl child of her parents (the only child in the family with no brother or sister). Enrolled in 1st year of regular Master's degree. Age <= 30 years. No family income ceiling restriction.

financials.raw_budget_text: Rs. 3,100 per month (Rs. 36,200 per annum) for a period of 2 years (tenure of PG course).

full_text_content:
UGC POST GRADUATE INDIRA GANDHI SCHOLARSHIP FOR SINGLE GIRL CHILD
Target: Only girl child in family pursuing Master's Degree (M.A., M.Sc., M.Com, etc.).
Grant: Rs. 36,200 per annum for 2 years. 3,000 fresh slots annually.

title: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Scheme (Dashmottar)
scheme_name: UP Dashmottar Scholarship (Class 11, 12, UG, PG, Diploma)
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open official UP Scholarship portal (scholarship.up.gov.in).
2. Click 'Student' tab -> Select 'Registration' -> Choose your category (General / OBC / SC / ST / Minority) -> 'Postmatric Other than Inter (Fresh)'.
3. Enter High School Board Roll Number, Name, DOB, and mobile linked with Aadhaar.
4. Log in with Registration ID -> Fill Income Certificate (आय प्रमाण पत्र) Application Number and Token.
5. Complete Aadhaar e-KYC authentication, print final application, and submit signed physical copy to your College Nodal Officer within 3 days.
brief_summary: Comprehensive state scholarship for Uttar Pradesh resident students. Covers 100% fee reimbursement (up to ₹50,000+) plus non-refundable fees and maintenance allowance for students studying in UP colleges or national institutes.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Universal State Fee Reimbursement for UP Resident Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 10th/12th and enrolled in recognized Post-Matric course
eligible_institutions: All UP State Colleges, Universities, AKTU, and National Institutes (IIT/NIT/CFTI) for UP domicile students
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Resident/Domicile of Uttar Pradesh. Annual family income <= Rs. 2,00,000 (for General, OBC, Minority) or <= Rs. 2,50,000 (for SC and ST candidates). Enrolled in recognized post-matric course.

financials.raw_budget_text: Full refund of approved tuition fee (up to Rs. 50,000/year for engineering/management/medical) plus annual maintenance stipend up to Rs. 10,000.

full_text_content:
GOVERNMENT OF UTTAR PRADESH — SCHOLARSHIP & FEE REIMBURSEMENT ONLINE SYSTEM
Covers: 100% tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance stipend for UP domicile students.
Income limit: Rs. 2.0 Lakhs (General/OBC/Minority) | Rs. 2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST). Apply on scholarship.up.gov.in.

title: MahaDBT Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open MahaDBT Portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in).
2. Click 'Post Matric Scholarship' -> 'New Applicant Registration' with Aadhaar.
3. Log in -> Under 'Directorate of Higher & Technical Education (DTE)', select 'Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)'.
4. Enter Centralized Admission Process (CAP) Application ID and college fee payment receipt.
5. Upload Tahsildar Income Certificate (<= 8 Lakhs) & Maharashtra Domicile Certificate.
brief_summary: Provides 50% tuition fee and examination fee reimbursement for economically weaker students in Maharashtra pursuing professional courses (Engineering, Medical, Pharmacy, MBA, Architecture, Polytechnic). Family income ceiling up to ₹8 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Tuition Fee Reimbursement for Economically Weaker Students in Maharashtra

eligibility.min_qualification: Admitted through CAP (Centralized Admission Process) into recognized professional course
eligible_institutions: All Govt, Aided, and Unaided Private colleges in Maharashtra
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Domicile of Maharashtra state. Family income <= Rs. 8 Lakhs per annum. Admitted through CAP rounds in recognized Degree/Diploma professional course. Max 2 children per family.

financials.raw_budget_text: 50% of total Tuition Fees and 50% of Examination Fees reimbursed directly to student / college account.

full_text_content:
GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA — MAHADBT DIRECT BENEFIT TRANSFER
RAJARSHI SHAHU MAHARAJ EBC SCHEME
Coverage: 50% Tuition and Exam fee waiver for Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, and Medical students.
Income limit: Rs. 8 Lakhs per year. Domicile: Maharashtra.

title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship for Meritorious Girls in Professional Graduation
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open Kotak Education Foundation Portal (kotakeducation.org/kotak-kanya-scholarship).
2. Click 'Apply Now' and register with student email and mobile OTP.
3. Fill in Class 12 Board score (>= 85%) and 1st year professional degree admission details (B.Tech / MBBS / Law / Design).
4. Upload family income proof (<= 6 Lakhs/year) and college fee structure.
5. Submit form directly online.
brief_summary: High-value CSR initiative providing ₹1,50,000 per year until completion of professional graduation (Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, Design, 5-Year Integrated LLB) for female students securing >= 85% in Class 12 with family income <= ₹6 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: High-Value Professional Degree Sponsorship for Meritorious Female Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Secured >= 85% marks in Class 12 Board examination and admitted to 1st year professional degree
eligible_institutions: NAAC/NIRF accredited Institutions across India
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Meritorious girl students who scored >= 85% in Class 12 board. Admitted to 1st year professional graduation (B.Tech, MBBS, Integrated Law, Design, Architecture). Annual family income <= Rs. 6,00,000.

financials.raw_budget_text: Rs. 1,50,000 per academic year until graduation to cover tuition fees, hostel, laptop, and academic expenses.

full_text_content:
KOTAK EDUCATION FOUNDATION — KOTAK KANYA SCHOLARSHIP 2026
Award: Rs. 1.5 Lakhs per year till graduation.
Target: Girl students admitted to 1st year professional courses (Engineering, Medical, Law) with 85%+ in 12th board. Income <= Rs. 6 Lakhs.

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Merit-cum-Means Scholarships
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open Reliance Foundation Scholarship Portal (scholarships.reliancefoundation.org).
2. Click 'Undergraduate Scholarships' -> Complete eligibility eligibility questionnaire (1st year UG, >=60% in 12th).
3. Fill in academic details and household income (<= 15 Lakhs).
4. Take the mandatory online aptitude test on the scheduled date.
5. Upload verified documents upon shortlisting.
brief_summary: 5,000 undergraduate scholarships awarded annually. Provides up to ₹2,00,000 grant over the degree duration to enable scholars to excel in their academic and leadership journey. Open to 1st-year UG students in all streams with family income up to ₹15 Lakhs (priority to <= ₹2.5 Lakhs).

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Empowering India's Brightest Undergraduates with Comprehensive Educational Grants

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 12th with min 60% marks and currently enrolled in 1st year full-time UG degree
eligible_institutions: Any recognized Degree College or University in India
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Indian resident enrolled in 1st year full-time undergraduate degree program in any discipline. Scored at least 60% in Class 12. Household annual income <= Rs. 15 Lakhs (preference to <= Rs. 2.5 Lakhs). Requires online aptitude test.

financials.raw_budget_text: Up to Rs. 2,00,000 across degree duration for tuition fees, books, laptops, and skill enhancement.

full_text_content:
RELIANCE FOUNDATION SCHOLARSHIPS 2026
Award: Up to Rs. 2 Lakhs for UG degree.
Slots: 5,000 students per year. Eligibility: 1st year UG in any stream, >=60% in 12th, family income <= 15 Lakhs.

title: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Support Scholarship (ECSS)
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open HDFC Bank Parivartan CSR Portal (hdfcbank.com).
2. Choose course level: School / Diploma / Graduation / Post-Graduation.
3. Fill personal information, family financial crisis explanation, and income proof (<= 2.5 Lakhs).
4. Upload previous academic marksheet (>=55%) and college bonafide certificate.
5. Submit form online.
brief_summary: Financial support for school, diploma, undergraduate, and postgraduate students from underprivileged backgrounds who are at risk of dropping out due to personal/economic crises. Provides up to ₹75,000/year.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Preventing Dropout and Supporting Underprivileged Students in Crisis

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed previous qualifying examination with at least 55% marks
eligible_institutions: Recognized Schools, Colleges, and Universities across India
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Indian students enrolled in Class 1 to 12, Diploma, UG, or PG courses. Annual family income <= Rs. 2,50,000. Minimum 55% marks in previous class.

financials.raw_budget_text: School (Class 1-12): Up to Rs. 35,000/year | Diploma/UG: Up to Rs. 45,000/year | Professional/PG: Up to Rs. 75,000/year.

full_text_content:
HDFC BANK PARIVARTAN'S ECSS SCHOLARSHIP
Need-based educational support up to Rs. 75,000/year for students facing financial hardship.
Eligibility: Family income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakhs, min 55% marks in previous exam.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree & Diploma)
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Click on 'Applicant Corner' -> 'New Registration (OTR)' to create your student profile with Aadhaar.
3. Log in with your OTR credentials and click 'Apply for Scholarship'.
4. Under 'AICTE Schemes' tab, select 'Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree/Diploma)'.
5. Enter Class 10th/12th marks, upload family income certificate (<= 8 Lakhs), and submit for college verification.
brief_summary: Empowers young women to pursue technical and engineering education. Provides ₹50,000 per annum for tuition, equipment, books, and software. Open to female students admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma in AICTE-approved institutions with annual family income up to ₹8 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Empowering Female Students in Technical & Engineering Education

eligibility.min_qualification: Class 12th (for Degree) or Class 10th (for Diploma) admitted to 1st year AICTE institution
eligible_institutions: All AICTE Approved Institutions & Universities
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Female student admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma course in an AICTE approved institution. Maximum 2 girls per family. Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 8 Lakhs per annum from all sources.

financials.raw_budget_text: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (max 4 years for Degree, 3 years for Diploma) as a single lump-sum grant for college fee, computer/laptop, books, and equipment purchase.

full_text_content:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR GIRL STUDENTS 2026
1. Objective: To provide encouragement and support to girl child to pursue technical education.
2. Total Number of Scholarships: 10,000 per annum (Central Quota) + State allocations.
3. Amount: Rs. 50,000 per annum towards college fee, books, equipment, laptops.
4. Eligibility: Female candidate admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma in AICTE approved college. Family income <= Rs. 8 Lakh/year. Maximum 2 girls per family.
5. Application Mode: Online submission via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or AICTE portal.

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
scheme_name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Differently Abled
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Click 'Applicant Corner' -> Complete One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar FaceAuth or Mobile OTP.
3. Log in to Student Dashboard -> Navigate to 'AICTE Schemes'.
4. Select 'Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Degree/Diploma)'.
5. Upload UDID Disability Certificate (>= 40% disability) and Income Certificate (<= 8 Lakhs).
brief_summary: Dedicated financial assistance to differently-abled students with disability not less than 40% pursuing technical degree or diploma courses. Provides ₹50,000 per annum for educational and assistive technology expenses.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Empowering Specially Abled Students in Higher Technical Education

eligibility.min_qualification: Admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma course in AICTE approved institution
eligible_institutions: AICTE Approved Technical Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Specially-abled candidate having disability of not less than 40%. Family income <= Rs. 8 Lakh per annum. Admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma in AICTE college.

financials.raw_budget_text: Rs. 50,000 per annum for tuition fees, purchase of books, stationery, accessible computer software, and assistive devices.

full_text_content:
AICTE SAKSHAM SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME
Target: Differently abled students (>= 40% disability) pursuing technical degree/diploma.
Amount: Rs. 50,000 per year. Eligibility: Admitted in AICTE institution, income <= 8 Lakhs/year.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP)
portal_navigation_steps: 1. Open National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Click 'New Registration / OTR' -> Authenticate using Aadhaar or DigiLocker.
3. Log in to Applicant Portal -> Under 'Department of Higher Education (Ministry of Education)', select 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship'.
4. Enter Class 12 Board Roll Number and Passing Year (System will auto-validate Board Top 20th Percentile Cutoff).
5. Upload Tehsildar Income Certificate (<= 4.5 Lakhs) and Bonafide College Admission receipt.
brief_summary: Flagship Ministry of Education scheme providing financial support to meritorious students from low-income families. ₹12,00,0/year for undergraduate years and ₹20,000/year for postgraduate studies. Requires >80th percentile in relevant 12th Board examination and income <= ₹4.5 Lakhs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Direct Financial Support to Meritorious College & University Students

eligibility.min_qualification: Passed Class 12th with above 80th percentile in respective State/CBSE/ICSE Board
eligible_institutions: Recognized Universities, Colleges, IITs, NITs, Medical & Arts Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board in Class XII. Family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 4.5 Lakhs per annum. Must pursue regular graduation/postgraduation.

financials.raw_budget_text: Rs. 12,000 per annum for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year of graduation; Rs. 20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies or 4th/5th year of professional courses.

full_text_content:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION — DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION
CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF SCHOLARSHIP FOR COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY STUDENTS (PM-USP)
1. Total Slots: 82,000 fresh scholarships every year (50% reserved for girls).
2. Rate of Scholarship: Rs. 12,000/year for Graduation; Rs. 20,000/year for Post-Graduation.
3. Eligibility: Above 80th percentile in Class 12 board, family income <= Rs. 4,50,000 per annum, pursuing regular recognized degree.
4. Mandatory: Bank account seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI mapping for DBT transfer.

title: DST WISE-KIRAN Postdoctoral Fellowship for Women in Science

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Re-entry and Fellowship for Women Researchers with Ph.D.

eligible_institutions: Any recognized Indian University / National Institute / Research Lab
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Unemployed women scientists and engineers aged between 27 to 45 years with a Ph.D. degree.

financials.raw_budget_text: Monthly fellowship of Rs. 55,000 + HRA + Rs. 2,00,000 annual research grant for 3 years.

full_text_content:
DST WOMEN IN SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING (WISE) POSTDOCTORAL FELLOWSHIP

Fellowship: Rs. 55,000/month + research grant. Rolling call open until 31 December 2026.

DEPARTMENT OF BIOTECHNOLOGY (DBT) & BIRAC
BIOTECHNOLOGY IGNITION GRANT (BIG) CALL 28

eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Faculty from State Universities and Colleges aged up to 45 years who wish to collaborate with mentors in CFTIs / IISc / IITs.

ANRF TEACHERS ASSOCIATESHIP FOR RESEARCH EXCELLENCE (TARE) 2026

title: NSP Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Higher Technical Education

eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Students admitted to 1st year of professional degree courses (B.Tech, MBBS, B.Pharm, MCA, MBA) with minimum 60% in 10+2 / Diploma.

financials.raw_budget_text: Monthly scholarship of Rs. 3,000 for girls (Rs. 36,000/year) and Rs. 2,500 for boys (Rs. 30,000/year) disbursed directly to bank account.

full_text_content:
NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (NSP) - MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
PRIME MINISTER'S SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (PMSS) 2026
Target: Meritorious UG/PG students in professional and engineering courses.
Benefit: Rs. 36,000 annually for female students and Rs. 30,000 for male students.
Deadline: 31st October 2026 (Extended till 30th November 2026).

title: AICTE Research Promotion Scheme (RPS) for Technical Institutions
brief_summary: Financial support to AICTE-approved engineering and polytechnic institutions to upgrade research infrastructure, undertake innovation in IoT, Robotics, EV technologies, and publish patents.

eligible_institutions: AICTE Approved Technical Institutions / Engineering Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Full-time faculty of AICTE approved technical institutions with minimum 5 years teaching/research experience.

financials.raw_budget_text: Grant-in-aid up to Rs. 25 Lakhs for modernization of laboratory equipment and research consumables.

full_text_content:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
RESEARCH PROMOTION SCHEME (RPS) 2026-27
Objective: Promoting research in technical institutes to create innovation and patents.

full_text_content:
DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (DST)
CALL FOR PROPOSALS: CORE RESEARCH GRANT (CRG) 2026
1. Objective: To promote individual-centric competitive research in high-impact national thrust areas including AI, materials, and quantum computing.
2. Eligibility: The Principal Investigator (PI) must hold a regular faculty position with Ph.D. in Science/Engineering. Age limit is 60 years. Co-PI from industry is welcome but not mandatory.
3. Budget Ceiling: Maximum funding up to Rs. 60,00,000 (INR 60 Lakhs) over 36 months.
4. Deadlines: Call opens on 01-07-2026. Proposals must be submitted via the online portal on or before 30-09-2026. Extended deadline: 15-10-2026.
5. Institution: CFTIs, Central/State Universities, and NAAC Accredited Private Institutions.
